scope: 40 whole auxiliary records inspected. Consolidated components compared with main meanings/stances and relevant access/treatment facets; pending parent repairs remain explicit.
additional_source_basis: Prior complete source/current-record/historical inspections and earlier full-page auxiliary rereads, especially 221, 241, 243, 246, 254–255, 257 and 277. This is not a new source-first pass.

rows.review_disposition: 86D retains trial and national consultation within factional conflict. Preserve the specific appeal-to-the-people division on 221–222; this is not a replacement for the independently developed trial subject.
A314 meaning/access expressly retain immunity removal, Marat’s acquittal and the unintended strengthening of popular pressure. No additional duplicate political-trial unit is needed.

8E3A meaning/access explicitly preserve Commission membership, arrests, contested abolition and the different outcomes on 31 May and 2 June. Consolidation is substantive, not inferred from shared dates.

BBD facet retains property fears and rich leaders’ reliance on workers, but its generic parent must also retain social coalition differences. Condition consolidation on the independently proposed repaired main meaning, rather than treating nested requirements alone as fulfillment.

BBD facet explicitly retains poor recruitment and reluctance to leave home; main fields need that military-capacity mechanism as well as political aims. Keep the contrast with Vendéan mobilization in the separately reviewed relationship/task repairs.
86D main meaning expressly includes the reluctant Plain. Preserve its uncommitted role and choice under pressure, not a third disciplined party.
86D main meaning notes shifting war policy; final retention must state changing factional positions, not presume a stable Girondin war/Montagnard peace binary.

0B38 main meaning/access explicitly compare Le Peletier, Marat and Chalier as politically constructed martyrs. Preserve Le Peletier’s assassination after the king’s trial and the comparative claim; no separate duplicate weight is necessary.

BBD facet/access retain the uneven Midi spread and Nîmes/Montpellier routes. Keep distinctions between enthusiastic cooperation, reluctance and frontier constraints; regional labels alone do not prove preservation.
Running heads and folios only are excluded; the substantive chapter title/body remain eligible.
Bare note callouts cannot establish absent endnote content. All substantive text on listed pages remains eligible.
Retire: 245–246 and 272–273 are whole-book eligible despite different chunk ownership.

Execution lists, military names and conspiracy defendants do not automatically require separate biographies. Preserve any distinctive action and separate alleged guilt from established role; a single mention can still matter.
Long quotations remain substantive evidence; length of quotation neither creates a biography nor makes the passage ineligible.
Retire duplicate ownership boundary: adjacent eligible pages are not source exclusions.

Campaign stage names can be subordinate, but Cholet, Granville, Loire crossings and failed coastal help carry military explanations. Preserve actual prose-based sequence and turning points; no excluded map route may supply it.
Witnesses supply violence and interpretation evidence without independent biography. Retain their claims as attributed testimony rather than suppressing source stance.

Figures substantiate different economic, judicial and demographic arguments. Keep distinctions among trials, sentences, shootings, battles and estimated aggregate mortality; no separate number heading is needed.
254–255/257 punitive names belong under specific repression subjects. Preserve symbolic functions and unequal implementation without multiplying trivial units.
Unavailable endnote matter cannot generate subjects. Supplied body statements at the boundaries remain eligible.

The broad defeat/reprisals component exceeds a Marseilles/Bordeaux-only parent. Explicitly bind the distinct Lyons and Toulon treatments and federalist context as well; preserve local variation and Caen conciliation, not an interchangeable general repression unit.

CC141’s source treatment retains Committee leadership subject to Convention supremacy. Its repaired main fields must preserve that constitutional/practical distinction rather than leave a generic institution reference.

CC141’s facet preserves national agents, reports, departmental bypass and abolition of local armies, with delayed implementation. Preserve those mechanisms in the final centralization requirement; no second Frimaire weight is necessary.

45B main meaning/stance expressly retain autonomous representatives and central recall for too much or too little severity. Consolidation preserves variation rather than assuming a uniformly moderating centre.

8A64 facet retains Lindet’s Subsistence Commission, transport/profit revisions, black markets, army purchasing and temporary assignat recovery. These substantive economic mechanisms require final parent retention beyond generic price controls.
72A main fields explicitly retain opposition to dechristianization, legal protection and continued persecution. The decree cannot be mistaken for immediate restoration of worship.

488D facet preserves Desmoulins’s journal, initial Robespierrist support, wrongful detention and failed committee of justice. Final parent meaning must retain these distinctions and Danton’s earlier coercive role, not only a generic moderation label.

7FD main fields/access explicitly preserve Ronsin’s army and Vincent’s ministry roles, failed mobilization and constructed foreign plot. Their actual institutional leverage must be kept separate from trial accusations.
C883 main meaning/access explicitly preserve Couthon’s limited courts/demolition and rejected conciliation before harsher mass repression. No duplicate biographical unit is required.
DFDC facet explicitly retains artillery taking the heights and making evacuation unavoidable. Parent repair must preserve that military mechanism; generic Bonaparte rise alone is insufficient.
60DA facet expressly preserves Turreau’s post-defeat destruction, including republicans, and separates it from combat/judicial mortality. Final main requirement must retain that distinction.
252 directly links citizen/tutoiement usage with suspicion; 7A343 main meaning and access retain that political conformity mechanism. No independent vocabulary unit is needed for this passage.
Only repeated running heads/page numbers are excluded, not the substantive Thermidor title or body text.
277 supplies no names for the two would-be assassins. Retain attempted attacks and alleged Batz plot under Robespierre insecurity, without importing historical external identities.

278 separates a convoy reaching France, Vengeur’s sinking recast by Barère as heroism, and Fleurus removing military danger. Keep both propaganda and declining emergency justification; Vengeur itself need not be separately weighted.
Anonymous reports establish perceptions of distress and politics, not standalone biographies. Preserve witness status and avoid turning reported complaints into unqualified social facts.
Collective Gilded Youth actions and constituency remain substantive. Unnamed individual attackers need no invented biographies; meaningful organizers with developed roles remain eligible.

283–284 press politics and 293 insurrection organization are distinct contexts. Preserve titles as appropriate routes through their actual parents, not a merged claim that every pamphlet belongs to one press subject.
Retire: 270–271 Hébertist destruction and constraints on independent coercive bodies remain whole-book eligible.
Retire: 297–298 counter-revolutionary origins/organization remain eligible; transition context is not semantic exclusion.
